q: Members asking or settling whether something the theme did not stage is real or a joke
w: A member warns 'Jews are planning to steal your logo on r/place' (an r/Israel plan for the spot), and another puts the pitchfork down on finding it was no joke: an alarm about an attack on the work, T3-005. T3-095's must_show says 'real or a joke' with no April Fools condition, so both readers took 'you weren't kidding' for its test.

q: If the room's members staged the claim, T3-001 even when readers test it
w: Most concepts are members' own fakes (the rickroll and butters link, fake teasers and releases, fake leaving posts) and the replies that catch or expose them, T3-001 even when tested; the tests of Scott's source-code change are T3-095; eight call the room's jokes uncreative, T3-032. Both readers put the tests of members' fakes under T3-095.

q: a fake sale or takeover by a character, company or rival sub
w: The moderators fake the sub's closure and move to Discord, a fake about the sub's own state, as at flashtv t05. Members work out whether it is April Fools, object to it as lame and an overstep, and play inside it ('You can't lock up the Flash', the Jay Garrick story), each in three or more concepts; T3-023 named by neither reader.

q: If the room's members staged the claim, T3-001 even when readers test it
w: Most concepts are members' own fakes (the pack-farming post, the fake card, NAXX is out, the free-pack announcement) and the replies exposing them, T3-001 even when tested; tests of claims from elsewhere (Forsen to Cloud9, linked images) are fewer, T3-095. Both readers put the tests of members' fakes under T3-095.

Nine concepts ask whether the unban, Marc's statement and the 30-day stream are April Fools and settle it; five judge Tyler's joke once known ('good joke tyler', 'kind of fucked up'), T3-048 by the boundary's larger share.

Most concepts test whether snapshots and a modded update video are real; a member's own fake snapshot and parrot joke, owned ('Hehe, success!') and judged, are T3-001, named by neither reader; four judge Mojang's joke feature once known, T3-048.

Members test whether Hi-Rez's launcher switch, the emote bug and the outage are jokes (T3-095); the moderators' lore tease, the fake Skye rework rickroll and the Kinessa proposal are the room's own fakes (T3-001); a member's proposed prank for Hi-Rez draws riffs and 'please dont give them ideas', wishing for the maker's joke (T3-048), as at paladins t02.

q: Members asking or settling whether something the theme did not stage is real or a joke
w: Members ask when the sub's own April Fools event will start and joke that no joke is the joke: waiting for the sub's own joke, which is not a test of whether something is real (T3-095), not the maker's joke (T3-048), and not a change made (T3-023), as at halo t01.
A member reports the pixel timer at twenty minutes and another settles it as Reddit's April Fools joke: a claim from outside settled, T3-095; nothing is worked around, so my B1 T3-074 was wrong.

A clip of missed shots opens with April Fools quips, and members then argue for thirty concepts whether the frames show misses or Glaz's confirmed hit-registration bug: ordinary game talk, T3-017. Nothing is asked about a joke, so T3-095 fails; both readers read the dispute as testing an April Fools claim.

Most concepts ask whether the Fate of the Furious DLC and the vegetable ranks are April Fools and are told, T3-095 by the boundary's larger share; fifteen anticipate, announce and judge Psyonix's known rank joke (the leak, 'Broccoli rank now boys', 'Called it'), T3-048 with concepts of its own, my B1 theme, left out by both readers.

Most concepts test outside stories (the frigate story, the Kingsley story) and say no headline can be believed today; members' own fake Sturgeon resignation and sedition arrest, redirected to r/shitepatter, have concepts of their own, T3-001.

Most concepts work out whether Bay's announcement, the Paradise takeover and the sub's own rules are April Fools; six judge the servers' jokes once known (10/10 for a good lol, NOT funny), T3-048 with concepts of its own.
Members ask whether the chibi mode is real and are told it is modded and April Fools only; three wish for a chibi mode to stay, T3-100 with concepts of its own, which my B1 grouping left out.

A real policy of free emergency treatment is posted and members ask who it covers, recall an earlier article and argue its demand: the sub's ordinary news talk, T3-017. One member suspects an April fool and another wishes it were, two concepts that do not carry the item; both readers placed T3-095.

Four concepts ask why the sub is mirrored and whether others see it, working out the change, T3-095 by T3-023's discriminator; two say it cannot be read and ask for a revert button, T3-097 with concepts of its own.

Members report the moving, blurry styling hurts their eyes, sickens them and eats CPU: the prank styling treated as something to get past, T3-097, which T3-032's must_not_show names; my B1 T3-032 was wrong.
A member reports the banner joke does not show on mobile and another blames Reddit: the styling reported as broken, T3-097, not an objection to the jokes as my B1 had it.
The moderators announce a return to usual activities and a later submission arrives after the event: the moderators ending the change, T3-097; my B1 T3-023 placed the change itself.

Members urge a yes vote in 4chan's poll to merge /pol/ and /mlp/ permanently and report the merger kept: a poll asked for so that an April Fools change can stay, which T3-100's test names; my B1 T3-048 and T3-066 missed it.

Most concepts ask CCP to make the corpse and booster joke features real, T3-100; a fan's fake leak and a fan project's scare title are members' fakes (T3-001), three judge CCP's joke as a joke (T3-048), and three recruit testers for the fan project (T3-017): four themes, more than three placements carry.

Members fall for the prank products and judge them better than the real gem store; no one asks for them to stay, and wanting them has two concepts, below the three T3-048's rule needs to add T3-100. Both readers placed T3-100.
Members decide to run the Taylor Survivor prank for real and ask for round two: a decision that an April Fools change stay, T3-100; my B1 T3-017 missed that the game was the joke.
Members turn Sentraq's S-Puck prank into a real build with plate thicknesses, cases and prototypes: a joke item made to outlive the day, T3-100; the build talk serves that, so my B1 T3-017 was wrong.

Five concepts want the joke Sonic Metroidvania made real, T3-100; four recommend existing games (AM2R, Sonic Chrono Adventure), the sub's usual talk with concepts of its own, which T3-017's rule adds and both readers left out.
